name: EPIC 210335817
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 8.6 solar radii and 1.09 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210335817 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.624482 (16th-84th percentiles 8.307003-9.058895), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,186 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.09 solar masses and 8.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,663 K at its surface.
